# Org Steering — Synced (do not edit)

Files in this folder are mirrored from the org knowledge base
(`kiro-guardrails-dist`) by the `kiro-sync` workflow. **Do not hand-edit them** —
changes are overwritten on the next sync. To change an org standard, open a PR
against `kiro-guardrails-dist`.

| File | Source in kiro-guardrails-dist |
|---|---|
| `coding-standards.md` | `steering/org-standards/coding-standards.md` |
| `test-conventions.md` | `steering/org-standards/test-conventions.md` |
| `security.md` | `steering/org-standards/security.md` |
| `design-template.md` | `steering/design-template.md` |

Synced version: see `.kiro/steering/org/.synced-version` (tracks the
`kiro-guardrails-dist` `VERSION` this content came from).
